description: Source code implementing AES-CCM encryption mode functions, including initialization, encryption, decryption, and AEAD context setup for different variants.

methods.name: CRYPTO_ccm128_init

methods.description: Initializes CCM128 state with nonce, AAD, and plaintext length, preparing for encryption/decryption.
